tagline: A reviving Indian Ocean gateway with a long resort coast in reach.
summary: Colombo anchors Sri Lanka's west coast — Port City Colombo's new waterfront, the southern resort belt (Bentota, Galle, Mirissa) and the Indian Ocean position toward the Maldives. Pioneer II suits the Colombo waterfront and near-coast resort hops; Quanta-LR's hybrid range opens the longer southern-coast corridors.

competitive_landscape: Sri Lanka has essentially no organised marine passenger transport along its resort coast — the southern belt is reached by road and rail. Colombo Port City, a major reclaimed-land development with a planned marina and waterfront, is creating a brand-new marine front from scratch, an open canvas for a premium clean-mobility layer.
seasonality: The SW monsoon (May–Sep) brings rougher seas to the west and south coasts; the season runs Nov–Apr. Foiling extends the comfortable window, and Quanta-LR range gives flexibility across the southern corridor.
regulatory_note: Marine activity falls under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and Merchant Shipping rules, with the Colombo Port City special economic zone (CPCC) offering a distinct development and investment frame for waterfront mobility.

precedents.why_it_matters: A neighbouring Indian Ocean precedent — clean foiling mobility at scale that Sri Lanka's reviving coast can follow.
